sense: of nature, not made by people

terms.gloss: natural, of nature, produced by nature
evidence: Cic. Brut. 36: nātūrālis, nōn fūcātus nitor (Lewis & Short)
Cic. N.D. 2.100: nātīvīs testīs, of sea creatures’ shells

phrases.latin: cibī pōtiōnisque dēsīderiō nātūrālī, nōn voluptāte modus fīnītus
phrases.english: what he ate and drank was measured by natural need, not by pleasure

phrases.latin: fīcī enim sēmen nātūrāle intus in eā fīcō, quam edimus, quae sunt minūta grāna
phrases.english: for the fig’s natural seed is inside the fig we eat: the tiny grains

sources: Lewis & Short: naturalis · Lewis & Short: nativus · Lewis & Short: natura
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 349, checked against the searchable text of the book (9 November 2026).

Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections (loci-livius, loci-varro), checked against the editions named there. Cicero, De natura deorum 2 and De finibus 4, checked against the Perseus Latin texts (9 November 2026).
